actions.name: Probe 1: Environment
actions.description: Dumps which globals and language features exist in the plugin sandbox. Read-only.

actions.name: Probe 2: Vars And Object Shapes
actions.description: Dumps the shape of _vars, track objects, playlist objects and custom tags. Read-only.

actions.name: Probe 3: Track Batching
actions.description: Calls getNextAllBatch a few times to learn the batch size. Read-only.

actions.name: Probe 4: Storage Round Trip
actions.description: Saves and loads several value types to learn what storage preserves. Touches only plugin storage.

actions.name: Probe 5: Settings Coercion
actions.description: Reports the runtime type of each declared setting. Read-only.

actions.name: Probe 6: Permission Denial
actions.description: Deliberately touches capabilities this action was NOT granted, and records how each one fails. Read-only.

actions.name: Probe 7: Modify Field Enforcement
actions.description: Writes to a permitted field (extra1) and a non-permitted field (extra2) on the SELECTED tracks. Select only tracks from the ZZ Plugin Harness Sandbox playlist before running.

config.confirmationMessage: This writes to extra1/extra2 on your SELECTED tracks. Only run with the sandbox playlist tracks selected.
